rawFindings.title: Incorrect check for root path in is.home helper
rawFindings.explanation: The original code allowed this.path to be '' or 'index.html' to signify the home page. The patch removes the check for 'index.html', so if this.path equals 'index.html', the helper returns false, which is inconsistent and can cause incorrect behavior for home page detection.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to return true when path is either '' or 'index.html', i.e., change line 26 to: if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;

rawFindings.title: Regular expression no longer matches 'index.html' suffix for pagination home path
rawFindings.explanation: The regular expression for the pagination directory home path was changed to remove optional matching of '(index.html)?' suffix. This makes the helper fail to detect paths like 'paginationDir/2/index.html' as home, which breaks expected behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the optional '(index\.html)?' suffix in the regular expression, i.e., change line 32 back to: r = regexCache.home[paginationDir] = new RegExp('^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$');

rawFindings.title: is.home helper uses this.path inconsistently with regex test
rawFindings.explanation: The original code used a local 'path' variable to run r.test(path), but the patch changes to use r.test(this.path). Although functionally equivalent, this inconsistency with previous usage could lead to confusion or errors if 'path' is modified before this usage.
rawFindings.suggestion: Assign this.path to a local variable 'path' earlier in the function for consistent usage, or revert to using the local 'path' variable in the r.test call.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect isHomeHelper path check may cause wrong home detection
rawFindings.explanation: The original code treated 'index.html' as home path and empty string as home, this change removed 'index.html'  check and only returns true for empty string paths, potentially breaking cases where path is 'index.html'.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check to return true if this.path is falsy or is 'index.html', e.g. if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true; instead of only checking for empty string path.

acceptedFindings.title: Incorrect isHomeHelper path check may cause wrong home detection

rawFindings.title: Incorrect property check for root path in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The original code checked for this.path being falsy or equal to 'index.html' to determine if the current path is the home. The new code only checks if this.path is exactly an empty string (''), omitting the 'index.html' case and the falsy path case, potentially causing incorrect behavior for home page detection.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check to match both '' and 'index.html' paths. For example, use: if (!this.path || this.path === 'index.html') return true;

rawFindings.title: Regular expression changed to one less restrictive for pagination detection in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The regular expression was changed from '^paginationDir/\d+/(index.html)?$' to '^paginationDir/\d+/', removing the optional '(index.html)?' suffix and the end-of-string anchor '$'. This broadens matches and may lead to false positives beyond intended pagination paths.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original regex to precisely match pagination paths including optional 'index.html' at the end and end of string anchor: new RegExp('^' + escapeRegExp(paginationDir) + '\/\d+\/(index\.html)?$');

rawFindings.title: RegExp tests path based on this.path instead of path variable in isHomeHelper
rawFindings.explanation: The previous code used a local variable 'path' to test the regex, now directly using 'this.path'. This change is likely okay since 'path' was assigned from 'this.path' but should be consistent.
rawFindings.suggestion: Consistency can be improved by assigning 'path' from 'this.path' and using 'path' in the regex test, or just consistently use 'this.path' throughout.
